diagnostic_access_checks.before_topup: A sequential probe returned HTTP 412 with an account-suspended/billing message; the user confirmed credits were exhausted. Per-case provider errors were not captured for every initial fallback.
diagnostic_access_checks.after_topup: An initial access check still fell back; a diagnostic probe then returned HTTP 200 and an AI report before the resumed evaluation.
